ANHANG ZUM EUROPÄISCHEN RECHERCHENBERICHT ÜBER DIE EUROPÄISCHE PATENTANMELDUNG NR.    EP 07 01 6606
In diesem Anhang sind die Mitglieder der Patentfamilien der im obengenannten europäischen Recherchenbericht angeführten Patentdokumente angegeben.
Die Angaben über die Familienmitglieder entsprechen dem Stand der Datei des Europäischen Patentamts am
Diese Angaben dienen nur zur Unterrichtung und erfolgen ohne Gewähr.
06-02-2008
paragraphs.en:
ANNEX TO THE EUROPEAN SEARCH REPORT ON EUROPEAN PATENT APPLICATION NO.    EP 07 01 6606
This annex lists the patent family members relating to the patent documents cited in the above mentioned European search report.
The members are as contained in the European Patent Office file on
The European Patent Office is in no way liable for these particulars which are given merely for the purpose of information.
06-02-2008
paragraphs.notes: The two sentences are printed in the order shown, which is the standard EPO form layout: the date 06-02-2008 is printed at the right below the block and completes the sentence ending 'am' (the state of the EPO file on 06-02-2008), not the sentence printed after it. 'EPO FORM P0461' is printed vertically in the left margin of the table. doc_part is set to 'search_report', which is outside the three values the V prompt enumerates (front_page, claims, description); none of the three fits an EPO search report annex, and inventing a value is safer than mislabelling this page as description. Flagging it here so a downstream consumer that switches on doc_part is not surprised.

The table has no caption number and no [00NN] marker; it is the body of the ANHANG form, so it is attached to the ANHANG block above it. Four cited documents, 42 family member rows in total (23, 13, 3, 3). The four groups are separated on the page by dashed rules, not by ruled cells; the first column is printed once per group and blank on the continuation rows, which the empty cells above reproduce. The kind code letter ('A') is printed in a separate sub-column from the document number in column 1 and has been joined to the number here. The table is read off the page image; the page has no text layer to confirm it against.

paragraphs.zh: Für nähere Einzelheiten zu diesem Anhang : siehe Amtsblatt des Europäischen Patentamts, Nr.12/82
paragraphs.en: For more details about this annex : see Official Journal of the European Patent Office, No.12/82
paragraphs.notes: Printed below the table frame. The space before the colon is as printed.

discrepancies.what: The V-pass briefing states that pages 15 to 22 are the eight figure sheets carrying the six Abbildungen, and that p22 is the last figure sheet. p22 is not a figure sheet at all.
discrepancies.drawing_says: p22 carries no plot, no axes and no figure label. It is the ANHANG ZUM EUROPÄISCHEN RECHERCHENBERICHT for application EP 07 01 6606, dated 06-02-2008: a four column patent family table. p21, checked to place p22 in context, is the EUROPÄISCHER RECHERCHENBERICHT itself. So the figure sheets are pages 15 to 20 only, six sheets for the six Abbildungen of [0018], and that mapping is one to one after all.
discrepancies.text_says: The briefing infers 'figure sheet' from the 19 character text layer. The inference does not hold: p21 and p22 also have no usable text layer because the EPO search report and its annex are inserted into the A1 PDF as page images, exactly as the figure sheets are. Absence of a text layer marks an image page, not a figure page.

blank_line_note: Blank lines inside paragraph zh/en were removed by the run owner. They came from the markdown-table convention this run uses to carry table content in the paragraph. build_enriched.py emits them into the enriched document, but english_by_line() in resolve_translations.py builds its `body` with `if t.strip()`, dropping blanks, while splitting the paragraph without dropping them. Any interior blank line therefore desynchronised the walk and it aborted, by design rather than guessing, which blocked verify.py for the whole run. Only whitespace-only lines were removed; every character of content is unchanged, asserted at the time of the edit.
